title: Power bound for the binary ceiling logarithm
statement: For every positive natural number $x$, the power $2^{\\operatorname{clog}_2(x)}$ is at most $2x$, where $\operatorname{clog}_2(x)$ is the least natural number $k$ such that $x\le 2^k$.
